findings.note: Pike is listed as a co-sponsor (not primary) of H825, Election Improvements. Section 4 changes the ID that goes with an absentee ballot request and returned absentee ballot: the State Board must set rules for photocopies of ID; a voter without a photocopy may sign an alternative affidavit giving the last four digits of the Social Security number plus a driver licence number, special ID card number or date of birth; the request form asks for the last four Social Security digits plus a licence or ID card number. The bill also bans ranked choice voting and shortens early voting. Last action on the page: referred to the Rules committee on 4/9/2025. The bill text version v0 was read at https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H825v0.pdf.

findings.note: Pike is listed as a co-sponsor (not primary) of H958, Election Law Changes. The filed text (dated Apr 10, 2025) covers absentee ballots, including rejection when the return envelope lacks a photocopy of ID or an affidavit. The latest edition (v9) adds a citizenship question and citizenship statement on registration applications and covers records of possible non-citizens on voter rolls. findings.note: Pike is listed as a co-sponsor (not primary) of H1231, No Voter Registration Changes At DMV. The bill text (dated May 11, 2026) amends G.S. 163-82.19: a licence or ID card applicant is asked whether they are a US citizen; a person who says no or declines to answer is told it is a felony for a non-citizen to register and is not offered voter registration.
